# Governed spawn observations, 2026-10-24

Source `773014a0184641b55199dddb0400ed190ccdecfb`.
[0044/HSE](../../../designs/harness-spawn-economics.md),
[guide](../../../harness-spawn-economics.md),
[security review](security-review.md), [sanitized receipt](receipt.json).
GT11A's strict peer/current receiver is qualified in this scope. The full
governed-command objective and installed GT9..11 remain open.

## Actual observations

| Instrument | Result | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| Ordinary and combined `task validate` | Pass, including race, vet, CUE and constitution checks | Local builds; combined tags `command_classifier,harness_maintenance` |
| Independent owned Mac CLI driver | 63/63 cases: 44 functional plus 19 receiver timing calls | Compiled commands and real SDK clock; synthetic policy/roster/state |
| Actual report/control CUE checks | 198/198 under 0.16.1 and 0.17.1 | 99 emitted/selected records; not source truth or authority proof |
| Actual pinned child processes | Exit0/1/2, stdout/stderr caps, stderr refusal, cancellation, hung process and inherited pipes pass | Test executable fixture; alternate dispatch exists only in test source |
| Injected receiver lifecycle | Required denials persist at advice0/partial/full, repeated attempts and synthetic maintenance; drift/cleanup/write faults hold | No real native signing or authentication |
| Independent source/guide review | Eight repaired findings, no remaining concrete finding in reviewed scope | Read-only review; not a complete host-security audit |
| Isolated strict matching-build plan proof | Ten claimed rows pass, zero fail; GT11A has direct static test reachability | Static proof, runtime attestations not ingested |
| Windows/Linux amd64 | Tagged test binaries compile | Not executed; native approval profiles remain unsupported |

The real driver covers explicit critic/worker class, model/effort/tier denial,
Claude fork/resume, Codex additive context-fork checks, malformed used fields,
unused nulls, exact pins and policy/profile/executable drift. Native rendering
returns silence on pass/resume and fixed exit2/stderr on denial/fault. The owned
driver suppresses its synthetic effect on refusal, producing two effects across
four native cases. This proves the driver, not Claude or Codex interception.

Operator-report counters total 138 valid SDK stamp processes, 40 evaluator
attempts/invocations/completions and 88 attempted/committed observed-clock writes.
These exclude native-run calls, which intentionally emit no counters. HMT init
receipts separately record zero native approval operations. No command in this
trial invokes approve, enrolls a key, calls a model or changes installed hooks.

## Performance

| Workload | Measured | Predeclared bar |
|---|---|---|
| Pure evaluator, 31 processes | p50 7.762 ms, p95 10.910 ms, max/first 46.078 ms | p95 <=25 ms |
| Protected receiver, 19 processes | p50 230.872 ms, p95/max 286.096 ms; first 276.555 ms | p95 <=500 ms, max <=1500 ms |
| Nine alternating legacy pairs | Bytes/status identical; before/after medians 9.700/8.012 ms, ratio0.826 | Ratio <=1.25 |

Every invocation starts a new process. The host had concurrent local gate and
cross-build work. OS/filesystem caches were not reset; a first sample is not a
cold-cache claim. The pure first sample exceeds 25 ms, while the declared p95
bar passes. Keep that startup outlier in deployment budgeting. Receiver calls
start three SDK clock processes and one evaluator and ordinarily commit two
clock observations. Logical writes are not physical syscall/IO counts.
The smaller paired median is not evidence of production cost or token savings.

An earlier complete retake had pure p95 4.192 ms, receiver p95/max263.607 ms and
legacy ratio0.964. It predates the final factory repair; retained for comparison,
not substituted for final source qualification. All failed attempts remain private.

## Source identity and failures

The commands were built from a dirty working tree based on `002ed135`, with
Go1.26.3 on the reported Mac. A 99-file source manifest is unchanged before/after
qualification and matches the source commit byte-for-byte. The receipt preserves
its digest and actual binary pins. This does not claim bit-reproducible builds.
The restored SDK binary matches the prior HMT a5 checksum; its source is unchanged.
This unit ran stamp, not a new SDK compile or native-consent qualification.

The first fixture had a 66-character sampling key and correctly held before the
evaluator. Another oracle expected controller_invalid where HC8 already specifies
controller_changed. A shared once-state directory contaminated the first legacy
comparison; independent per-binary/pair state repaired the driver. The final roster
was selected before its fresh fixture run and the latency bars were not increased.

INC-25 is a product defect found by the final executable drift case: typed-nil
preparation interfaces overwrote a diagnosis, and an invalid native pin caused
actual maintenance panic stderr. Three factory assertions failed before explicit
nil returns repaired them. Final actual native-negative cases hold with fixed
native_unavailable, no stderr stack and zero native invocations. No authority grant
or source disclosure was observed. The review records other repaired development
findings, including strict policy bytes, state reload, framing and pipe drain.

The test-only process fixture initially encountered Go's successful race-exit drain
and Darwin's unsupported FIFO read deadline. It now uses direct fixture exit and
an owned file/FIFO handshake, without changing production environment or deadlines.
An observation script initially treated legacy hook envelopes as HSE records; the
final explicit version roster excludes them and verifies their bytes separately.

Source/evidence publication `2f0ed91` passed normal pre-push validation (124.51 s)
and Fathom verification (65.47 s). The two empty worker worktrees and three merged
local branches were removed after a verified Git bundle retained their references.
No additional remote branch or stash was present at the reconciliation check.

Hosted publication produced three terminal startup refusals:
[HMT](https://github.com/GeoffMillerAZ/agentic-kit/actions/runs/40155382402),
[CI](https://github.com/GeoffMillerAZ/agentic-kit/actions/runs/40155382476) and
[native observations](https://github.com/GeoffMillerAZ/agentic-kit/actions/runs/40155382432).
All eight jobs ran zero steps; all eight annotations confirm refusal before startup.
Private diagnostics are retained privately. No account/policy change or retry was
performed. Hosted execution stays unknown. Workflow source or local success cannot
fill that gap. Actual host delivery/crash behavior,
live key/user presence, installed authority, other native approval profiles,
power-loss durability, journal adoption and production economics stay unqualified.
